name: one-machine window value uses the shortest tail
description: a, b and d run on engine 0 (2 each) and all must precede out (engine 1, 1); a reaches out through c (engine 1, 2). Engine 0 works 6 inside the window and its last operation is followed by at least out (1), so the window is at least 0 + 6 + 1 = 7 (max(chain 5, loads 6) gives only 6). The optimum is 7: a first, then c alongside b and d, then out. Taking the longest tail after an engine-0 operation (a's 3) instead of the shortest would claim 9.
